title: Bounded protocols for connected envy-free proportional cake cutting
area: Algorithmic game theory, mechanism design and fair division
formal: For every fixed n≥4, is there a bounded-query Robertson–Webb protocol that gives n agents connected pieces that are envy-free and each worth at least 1/n of that agent's total cake value, allowing free disposal?
context:
Assume nonatomic normalized nonnegative additive valuations. Approximate proportionality and disconnected allocations do not meet the target.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: Asks whether discarded cake permits exact fairness together with geometric simplicity in finite interaction.
